summary: Cockpit Phase 1 tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 API tests pass (accessible-companies gating, Today shape+filter, Close-Board shape, advance semantics with 409 on unmet pre-checkpoints). Frontend: sidebar entry visible only for pro (hidden for client role), /cockpit renders CockpitToday with all required testids, filter chips work (red urgency → 3 cards), /cockpit/close renders all 7 phase columns with 84 cards, month nav works, all 6 coming-soon stub pages render with correct testids. Client direct-nav to /cockpit → empty-state renders (backend returns 403 as expected).

issues: cockpit-close-summary testid is conditionally rendered only when overdue_count>0 OR at_risk_count>0. Recommend always rendering the container (empty state) so downstream tests + a11y readers see a stable landmark. Non-blocking.

When client@axiom.ai navigates directly to /cockpit, the 403 backend response is silently swallowed and only a generic 'Inbox zero — Nothing needs your attention' is shown. Consider surfacing the backend message ('Cockpit is a cross-client surface — your account only manages one book.') so the empty state is self-explanatory. Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Always render cockpit-close-summary container (with empty state) for stable testid presence.
OPTIONAL: On /cockpit Today feed when API returns 403, show the backend detail message instead of the generic inbox-zero card.
critical_code_review_comments: cockpit.py:596 — bare `except Exception:` after `y, m = [int(x) ...]` swallows ValueError but the `raise HTTPException` is inside the try? Actually re-raise is correct via HTTPException; fine.

cockpit.py:_close_card fires N sequential Mongo queries per company (O(N)). With 21 accessible companies the endpoint takes ~1-2s. PRD note acknowledges this for Phase 1 — consider batching status lookups in Phase 2.

cockpit.py `close_board_advance`: when to_phase='closed' but pre-checks pass, it upserts month_close_signoffs + close_periods but does NOT audit-log via close_phase_intents inside a single transaction. If the second write fails the state is partially applied. Low risk for Phase 1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cockpit Phase 1 is production-ready. All PRD § 10 testids present. Only cosmetic suggestions above. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_cockpit_api.py can be reused as regression suite for future Cockpit phases.
